loggingInfrastructureAudit.technicalLimitationNote: Because MySQL log_bin and general_log are set to OFF in the server configuration, MySQL does not retain binary row change logs or raw query execution history for table updates and deletions.

scripts.sourceCode:
<?php
// Stage fixture order
$order = wc_create_order(['status' => 'completed']);

$variations = [
  ['id' => 271, 'slug' => 'keo-gay-1m8'],
  ['id' => 272, 'slug' => 'keo-gay-2m'],
  ['id' => 273, 'slug' => 'keo-gay-2m5'],
  ['id' => 274, 'slug' => 'keo-tron-1m2'],
  ['id' => 270, 'slug' => 'keo-tron-1m5'],
];

foreach ($variations as $v) {
  $var_product = wc_get_product($v['id']);
  $order->add_product($var_product, 1, [
    'variation' => ['pa_kich-thuoc' => $v['slug']]
  ]);
}

$order->calculate_totals();
$order_id = $order->get_id();

// Inspect order items and metadata
$items_data = [];
foreach ($order->get_items() as $item_id => $item) {
  $product = $item->get_product();
  $items_data[] = [
    'item_id' => $item_id,
    'product_id' => $item->get_product_id(),
    'variation_id' => $item->get_variation_id(),
    'name' => $item->get_name(),
    'sku' => $product ? $product->get_sku() : null,
    'price' => $product ? (float)$product->get_price() : null,
    'line_total' => (float)$item->get_total(),
    'meta_data' => $item->get_meta_data(),
    'variation_meta' => $item->get_meta('pa_kich-thuoc')
  ];
}

$output = [
  'order_id' => $order_id,
  'order_status' => $order->get_status(),
  'order_total' => (float)$order->get_total(),
  'item_count' => count($items_data),
  'items' => $items_data
];

echo "===JSON_START===" . json_encode($output) . "===JSON_END===";

<?php
add_filter('woocommerce_email_enabled', '__return_false');
add_filter('woocommerce_email_classes', '__return_empty_array');

$order = wc_create_order(['status' => 'completed']);
$variations = [271, 272, 273, 274, 270];

foreach ($variations as $vid) {
    $var_product = wc_get_product($vid);
    if ($var_product) {
        $order->add_product($var_product, 1);
    }
}
$order->calculate_totals(false);
$order_id = $order->get_id();

$items_summary = [];
foreach ($order->get_items() as $item_id => $item) {
    $items_summary[] = [
        'item_id' => $item_id,
        'product_id' => $item->get_product_id(),
        'variation_id' => $item->get_variation_id(),
        'name' => $item->get_name(),
        'total' => $item->get_total(),
        'kich_thuoc_meta' => $item->get_meta('pa_kich-thuoc')
    ];
}

echo json_encode([
    'order_id' => $order_id,
    'total' => $order->get_total(),
    'items' => $items_summary
], JSON_PRETTY_PRINT | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);

<?php

}
